title: I met someone in The Mall
content: I was sitting in the mall atrium with other people. There was a woman around 30 with dark skin and hair in a white summer dress sitting next to me. She was reaching into a bag and took out something like a protein bar. She looked at me and asked me if I wanted it. I said thank you and asked if she was there to meet new people in Mall World too? She just smiled. I hope we find each other again. This is typical of my dreams here, just doing normal things but in a surreal sense . I hope someday I meet the same person in both worlds. Maybe I have and that’s why some people seem so familiar.
